title: Local direct-image stalk and total cohomology with section-class normalization
statement: Let f:X→Y be a morphism of schemes, y∈Y, F an O_X-module, p≥0, A=O_{Y,y}, c:Spec(A)→Y, X′=Spec(A)×_Y X, f′ the first projection, g′ the second projection and F′=g′*F. There exists an A-linear equivalence from (c_*R^p f′_*F′)_y to H^p(X′,F′), with scalars via Gamma-Spec followed by f′.appTop. For every injective resolution I of F, K of F′, neighborhood V of y, and compatible FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices D for f,c,F,I,K,V, set W=g′^{-1}(f^{-1}V). For every xi∈H^p(W,F′|W), restriction of e(germ_V(D.targetClass p xi)) to W equals xi. This statement involves neither an auxiliary module G nor an arbitrary comparison beta. [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices] [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-resolution-construction] [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]

source.place: Proof: closed-point stalk = global sections = total cohomology, before formal functions; the resolution normalization is Tag 01E4 and restriction functoriality Tag 01FB.

proof.text: For every neighborhood V of y, c^{-1}V=Spec(A). Thus the stalk of c_*N at y identifies with Gamma(Spec(A),N). On Spec(A), every open containing the closed point is top, so global evaluation is its stalk and is exact. The structure-sheaf germ compatibility identifies its A action with restriction through Gamma-Spec.

Apply exact evaluation to f′_*K. Evaluation commutes with homology, and global sections of f′_*K are global sections of K. The right-derived resolution comparisons identify this homology with H^p(X′,F′). Its scalar map is Gamma-Spec followed by f′.appTop. This gives the equivalence independently of I,K,V,D.

The pullback-square open equality identifies W with f′^{-1}(c^{-1}V)=X′. Expand D.targetClass: exact evaluation cancels sectionCohomologyTheta, sheafification, evaluation-homology and the higher-direct-image resolution comparison. D.target.components identifies its section-complex comparison with restriction; D.target.augmentation identifies its resolution map with the augmented canonical comparison. Resolution comparison lifts are homotopic, so the resulting map equals the resolution-defined moduleCohomologyFMap for the restriction unit, for every supplied D. This proves restriction of the resulting class equals xi.

theorem localDirectImage_stalk_cohomology {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y)
    (F : X.Modules) (p : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Y.toRingedSpace y).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).obj
        (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).rightDerived
          p).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F)))
      ≃ₗ[Y.presheaf.stalk y]
      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f).toRingedSpace p ⋙
        ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv ≫
            (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f).appTop).hom).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F),
      ∀ (I : InjectiveResolution F)
        (K : InjectiveResolution
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F))
        (V : Y.Opens) (hy : y ∈ V)
        (D : Scheme.Modules.FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f (Y.fromSpecStalk y) F I K V)
        (xi : (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
            ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
              ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F)))),
        Scheme.Modules.moduleCohomologyFMap
          ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction
            ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι).unit.app
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F)) p
          (e.toLinearMap (TopCat.Presheaf.germ
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).obj
              (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).rightDerived
                p).obj
                ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj
                  F))).presheaf V y hy (D.targetClass p xi))) = xi
